spanish: Y subió tendido del rocío, y he aquí sobre faz del desierto fino escamado, fino como la escarcha sobre la tierra.

findings.issue: Plural construct פני is smoothed to singular faz; the sense remains one face or surface.
כפור is absolute, with no article; la is Spanish article smoothing on a generic comparison.
The comma binds fino escamado to desierto and sets the second fino apart; both דק phrases are parallel and the tokens name no head.

notes: Qal 3sg subió, construct tendido del rocío, repeated fino, and the frost comparison stay inside the tokens.
